name: Cyberspace Corporation
summary: Melbourne dialup/ISDN/ADSL + hosting + online-backup ISP; retail ISP wound down c. 2010, domain then redirected to Montimedia (CYBERSPACE CORPORATION PTY. LTD., ACN 071 433 666).

events.details: Dialup/ISDN/dedicated access + hosting; earliest homepage capture Jan 1997. Later added broadband ADSL and online data backup.
Live ADSL/dialup/hosting ISP homepage still served through 2009 (copyright 2006); from Sep 2010 cyberspace.net.au 301-redirected to montimedia.com.au and never returned a retail homepage again.
